name: Aura of Pli Xin Liako
description: Creates an aura around you that applies Aura of Pli Xin Liako Effect to your companions, which increases their attack speed by 25%, spell damage by 33%, triple attack rate by 25%, their chance to flurry by 22%, and their companions' chance to flurry by 28% as long as they stay inside the area of the aura.
